# Legacy QuarkXPress import fixtures

These files are the upstream libqxp 0.0.3 test corpus, covered by its MPL-2.0
source distribution in `splatworks/layoutsplat/quark/source/`. The 3.3 and 4.x
Windows text samples exercise real browser parsing. The 5.x detection sample
verifies rejection without replacing the open publication. No private user
publications are distributed.
